content.title: Chapter 23 - CABLE FRANCHISE APPLICATION AND PROCESS — Sec. 23-42. - Non-CFAR franchise applications.

              …

faqs.a:
Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter, any competitive cable services
               franchise applicant may elect to submit a cable franchise application to Arvada and/or
               engage in cable franchise negotiations without regard to the application of the FCC
               CFAR. In such cases, Arvada will negotiate the terms of a competitive cable franchise
               without regard to 47 CFR § 76.41 and the other provisions of this chapter. Agreement
               by any applicant to negotiate a franchise without regard to 47 CFR § 76.41 and the
               other provisions of this chapter shall not be deemed by Arvada to effect a waiver
               of any applicant's right under applicable law to trigger application of 47 CFR § 76.41
               and this chapter, where applicable.
(
Ord. No. 4078, § 1, 7-16-07
)
